changes.summary: Add async long-running operation primitive (#866): pkg/jobs with a Redis-backed (or in-memory) TTL-evicted job store, in-process runner pool with progress reporting and heartbeats, polling endpoints under /jobs with result streaming, and standard trigger/operations/download templ components with retry and dismiss. No database tables or RBAC additions.
Add chrome.placements: 'flat' so a composed Lens report renders each placement as its panels alone, leaving the dashboard header as the one filter and action row.
Add approved Linux visual baselines for the flat report placement stories.
Cover the flat report placement stories in the Lens visual regression manifest.
Give the shared-execution cancellation test timing headroom on loaded CI runners.
Sidebar navigation follows effective permissions: a user without own roles who holds permissions directly or through a group role sees the menu again instead of an empty sidebar.
